faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: What people ask most before signing up.

items.q: Why does Tendrik show fewer tenders than other services?
items.a: Other services often quote every tender they've ever recorded – including ones that closed years ago. We only show active tenders you can apply for right now. Expired tenders are removed automatically so you don't have to dig through outdated calls.

items.q: Where does the data come from?
items.a: From official public sources: TED (Tenders Electronic Daily – the EU-wide gazette), the ÚVO gazette (Slovak Public Procurement Office), EKS (Electronic Contracting System), JOSEPHINE (a below-threshold platform used by cities, hospitals and regions) and ITMS21+ (Slovakia Programme – official OpenData API for EU-funded grant calls).

items.q: How often are tenders and calls updated?
items.a: Every day we pull new tenders from all four sources and drop the ones past their deadline. Grant calls are synced overnight. In practice you see the current state of what's biddable today.

You get 30 days free to try (including 5 AI tender analyses), then €4.99 / month (Basic – tender monitoring), €14.99 / month (Premium – tenders + 30 AI analyses) or €24.99 / month (Komplet – tenders, grants and 150 AI analyses); yearly 49 / 149 / 249 €. Final price – Tobify s. r. o. is not a VAT payer. No card required at signup – we'll reach out before the trial ends. Cancel anytime.

Small and medium businesses, tradespeople, IT and construction firms, consultants, service providers, local governments, non-profits and schools – anyone who wants to bid on public tenders or grant calls without trawling several different portals every day.

items.q: What grants and subsidies do you track?
items.a: We currently cover EU-funded grant calls from the Slovakia Programme via the official ITMS21+ OpenData API. This is not a complete list of every subsidy scheme in Slovakia, and we are expanding sources gradually. Details are available in the Grants section.
